key_insight: Energy-Guided Transport steers flow-matching samples toward physical constraints using continuous energy-based forces instead of discrete projections.
engineering_relevance: The training-free approach can improve physical consistency and inference efficiency when generating PDE-governed systems without retraining the generative model.
method: Express nonlinear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy.
Apply a continuous dissipative force to intermediate states during ODE integration.
Compute the force implicitly with reverse-mode automatic differentiation, with claimed O(N) algorithmic complexity.
evidence_signal: Across 1D and 2D physical systems, including chaotic Navier–Stokes equations, the abstract reports stable generation, improved stability–accuracy trade-offs, and faster inference than exact projection strategies.
watch_item: Continuous energy guidance does not by itself guarantee exact constraint satisfaction; residual violations and sensitivity to guidance strength should be checked.
paper_title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
